question: A network engineer needs to configure system logging on the Cisco MDS Series switch. The messages must be displayed with the severity level of 'warning' and above. For security reasons, the users must be logged out of the console after 5 minutes of inactivity. Which configuration must be applied to meet these requirements?
options:
MDS-A(config)# line console
MDS-A(config-console)# speed 38400
MDS-A(config-console)# exec-timeout 5
MDS-A(config)# logging console 4

MDS-A(config)# console
MDS-A(config-console)# speed 38400
MDS-A(config-console)# session-limit 5
MDS-A(config)# logging console 5
theory: Cisco syslog severity levels run from 0 (emergency, most severe) to 7 (debugging, least severe), so setting 'logging console 4' displays messages at severity 4 (warning) and all more severe levels (0-4), matching the requirement. Independently, the exec-timeout command configured under line console sets the idle-session timeout (in minutes) after which an inactive console session is automatically logged out, here set to 5 minutes as required. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - general MDS/NX-OS logging and line configuration)
